# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 106 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 52 | Coptic

---

## Saying 106

Jesus said: "When you unite the two into one, you will become children of humanity — and if you tell a mountain to move, it will move."

---

**Translator's Notes (PNEUMA):**

- "Unite the two into one" — unification as active joining
- "Children of humanity" — *shēre mrōme* as generic humanity rather than the messianic title
- "Tell a mountain to move" — the command as speech act
